dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin has little utility. It's not adopted by merchants. It hasn't finite supply. It lacks support for smart contracts.

So buy BCH and fasten your belts!

Bitcoin should be a "peer to peer electronic cash system" and not gold. BTC is a disfunctional fork of Bitcoin.
Ethereum has been created as a smartcontract blockchain and V.Buterin said explicitly it's not a currency.
Dogecoin is useless.

Bitcoin is BCH and wirex hasn't it yet.
